title: Ex-Google Recruiter Explains: The Interview Secret to Getting Hired
description:
Get my Job Seekers Toolkit: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/get-my-job-seekers-toolkit-now
 Book a 1:1: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/book-a-1hour-career-coaching-session-with-me-eq3bs

Most people don’t lose money because of their salary.
They lose it because of career habits that quietly keep them underpaid for years.

After a decade recruiting for Google, Uber, and TikTok, I’ve seen the same patterns over and over again, talented people who stay stuck at the same compensation level because they rely on habits that make them look junior, reactive, or replaceable.

In this video, I break down the 8 career habits that cost professionals $50K-$100K every year without realizing it, and how to replace them with habits that hiring managers actually reward.

 You’ll learn:
• The habits that make you look less senior than you are
• Why “working hard” keeps you stuck at the same pay
• How top performers position themselves for bigger roles
• The mindset shift that increases your market value
• What hiring managers look for that most candidates never show

Your value is higher than what you’re being paid for right now.
These habits are the reason.
Fix them, and your earning potential changes fast.
